title: Flowette: Flow Matching with Graphette Priors for Graph Generation
abstract: arXiv:2602.23566v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study generative modeling of graphs with recurring subgraph motifs. We propose Flowette, a continuous flow matching framework that employs a graph neural network-based transformer to learn a velocity field over graph representations with node and edge attributes. Our model promotes topology-aware alignment through optimal transport-based coupling and preserves structural fidelity through endpoint-aware and chemistry-aware regularisation. To incorporate domain-driven structural priors, we introduce graphettes, a new probabilistic family of graph structure models that generalize graphons via controlled structural edits for motifs such as rings, stars, and trees. We theoretically analyze the coupling, invariance, and structural properties of the framework, evaluate it on synthetic and molecular benchmarks, and isolate the contributions of the structural prior, the optimal-transport coupling, and the regularisation terms through

translated_title: Flowette：基于Graphette先验的流匹配图生成方法
translated_abstract: 我们研究具有重复子图motif的图生成建模。我们提出了Flowette，一个连续流匹配框架，它采用基于图神经网络的transformer来学习带有节点和边属性的图表示上的速度场。我们的模型通过基于最优传输的耦合来促进拓扑感知的对齐，并通过端点感知和化学感知的正则化来保持结构保真度。为了融入领域驱动的结构先验，我们引入了graphettes，这是一种新的图结构概率模型族，它通过对环、星形和树等motif进行受控结构编辑，从而对graphon进行了泛化。我们从理论上分析了该框架的耦合、不变性和结构性质，在合成数据和分子基准数据集上进行了评估，并通过消融实验分离了结构先验、最优传输耦合和正则化项各自的贡献。
tldr: 提出Flowette框架，将连续流匹配与新型graphette结构先验相结合，利用最优传输耦合和化学感知正则化，实现具有重复子图motif的图生成。
en_tdlr: Flowette combines continuous flow matching with novel graphette structural priors, leveraging optimal transport-based coupling and chemistry-aware regularization to generate graphs with recurring subgraph motifs.
